name: G01 the holders are counted again, so a failed count reads as none
G02 an answer that is no result is taken for no holders
G03 the exception of the driver is taken for no holders
find: throw new RoleException(RoleError::ReadFailed, "The holders of the role {$roleId} could not be counted.", [], $exception);

name: G04 the exception of the driver is let through as it is
find: throw new RoleException(RoleError::ReadFailed, "The holders of the role {$roleId} could not be counted.", [], $exception);

name: G05 the refusal of a count that failed says the role is in use
find: RoleError::ReadFailed, "The holders of the role {$roleId} could not be counted.");
replace: RoleError::InUse, "The holders of the role {$roleId} could not be counted.");

name: G06 the deletion of a role never asks who holds it
G07 the deletion of a role swallows the refusal of the count
G08 the employees that were deleted are counted as holders
find:
->select('COUNT(*) AS holders', false)
            ->join('employees e', 'e.person_id = er.person_id AND e.deleted = 0')
